'''Wroona''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[near-Human]] [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonians]], located in the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]].

==Description==
It was a small blue world, located at the far edge of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories,<ref name="TCSWE" /> in the same quadrant and region as [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. It was covered by great [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] divided up by long continents, creating thousands of miles of blue-sand coasts.

==History==
Wroona had a long tradition of seafaring, naval commerce, and materialistic spirituality. It was a wealthy tradeworld in the galactic community, located on the [[Keller's Void/Legends|Keller's Void]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] shortcut. The Wroonians established many colonies, such as that on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

The planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> However, this planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during said [[Clone Wars/Legends|conflict]]. The Wroonians were more than willing to engage in military force to ensure [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would surrender his emergency powers.

With the rise of the militaristic [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Wroona's strategic location gained new importance. The Empire established an Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], dispatched an Imperial governor to rein in the Wroonian trade [[Wroonian Guilds|guilds]], and built a small but vital shipyard and resupply post, the [[Wroona Stardock]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], members of the disbanded [[Guild of Armament Distributors]] [[Raid on the Wroona Stardock|raided]] the Stardock and damaged the Imperial [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Rampant]]'' despite the efforts of Governer [[Norrin]].

[[Starship Outfitters]]<ref name="PSG" /> and [[Palestro's Wholesale Firearms]] were two businesses there.<ref name="CRO" />
